classes.name: MembersPage
classes.description:
Represents the Members list page at /projects/:id/members.
Shows project members in a table with options to add, filter, and manage members.
The "+ Member" button toggles an inline form for adding new members.

Sidebar navigation: All | Locked | Invited, Project roles, Work package shares.
Filter panel: Status, Role, Work package shares, Name.

methods.name: memberTable
methods.description:
Returns the member table component, used to count members, list their
names, and reach individual rows for role changes or removal.
methods.observableState: None — returns a component wrapper without interacting

methods.name: openAddMemberForm
methods.description:
Opens the inline add member form via the "+ Member" button. Idempotent —
if the form is already open this does nothing.
methods.observableState: The inline add member form is visible, exposing the user search field and role dropdown

methods.name: isAddMemberFormVisible
methods.description: Checks whether the inline add member form is currently visible.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: closeAddMemberForm
methods.description:
Closes the inline add member form. Idempotent — does nothing if the form
is already closed.
methods.observableState: The add member form is hidden and no member is added

methods.name: selectMemberToAdd
methods.description:
Selects the principal to add in the inline add member form: types the
given name or email into the user search field and picks the matching
entry from the autocompleter. When the value is an email address with no
existing account, the autocompleter offers an "invite by email" entry —
this selects that entry, which is what turns the submission into an
external invite.
methods.prerequisites: The inline add member form is open — call {@link openAddMemberForm} first
methods.observableState: The chosen user or email is selected in the add form's search field; nothing is persisted until the form is submitted

methods.name: selectRole
methods.description:
Selects a role in the inline add member form's role dropdown. This sets
the role for the member about to be added; it does not change the role of
an existing member (use {@link MemberTableRowComp.clickManageRoles} for
that).
methods.prerequisites: The inline add member form is open — call {@link openAddMemberForm} first
methods.observableState: The role dropdown shows the given role as selected; nothing is persisted until the form is submitted

methods.name: submitAddMemberForm
methods.description:
Clicks "Add" to submit the inline add member form, waits for the create
request to complete, and returns the reloaded Members page so the members
table reliably reflects the new member.

Submitting posts the form and the server redirects to the members list
with `?status=all`, so this is a full page load rather than a Turbo swap.
methods.prerequisites: A principal and a role have been chosen in the open add member form
methods.observableState: The member is created, the add form closes, and a new row appears in the members table

methods.name: addMember
methods.description:
Adds a member end to end: opens the add form if needed, selects the user
or email, assigns the role, and submits. Use this when a test only needs
a member to exist; drive {@link selectMemberToAdd}, {@link selectRole}
and {@link submitAddMemberForm} separately when it needs to observe or
assert on the intermediate form state.
methods.prerequisites: The Members page is open and the named user (or email) can be granted the role
methods.observableState: The member is added and appears as a new row in the members table

methods.name: showAllOnOnePage
methods.description:
Reloads the current members view with a page size large enough to hold
the whole list, so row lookups do not depend on which page a member
happens to land on. Preserves the active `status` view.

The members list paginates at 20 by default. `MemberTableComp` can only
see rendered rows, so without this a lookup for a member on page 2
reports it missing — a false negative that looks exactly like the member
never having been created.
methods.observableState: The members table renders up to 100 rows of the current status view on a single page

methods.name: openFilter
methods.description:
Opens the filter panel and waits for its Apply button, making the filter
fields usable.
methods.observableState: The filter panel opens, exposing the Status, Role, and Name filter fields

methods.name: filterByName
methods.description:
Types a name into the filter panel's Name field and applies the filter,
waiting for the resulting page load.
methods.prerequisites: The filter panel is open — call {@link openFilter} first
methods.observableState: The members table reloads showing only members matching the name

methods.name: clearFilter
methods.description: Clears all active filters and waits for the resulting page load.
methods.prerequisites: The filter panel is open — call {@link openFilter} first
methods.observableState: The members table reloads showing the unfiltered member list

methods.name: clickSidebarAll
methods.description: Navigates to the "All" members view via the sidebar link.
methods.prerequisites: The Members page is open and the current view is not already "All"
methods.observableState: The table reloads showing every member regardless of status

methods.name: clickSidebarLocked
methods.description: Navigates to the "Locked" members view via the sidebar link.
methods.observableState: The table reloads showing only members whose account is locked

methods.name: clickSidebarInvited
methods.description: Navigates to the "Invited" members view via the sidebar link.
methods.observableState: The table reloads showing only members with a pending invitation

methods.name: hasMemberWithName
methods.description:
Checks whether a member with the given name exists in the table.
Convenience delegate to {@link MemberTableComp.hasMemberWithName}.

Only inspects the rows currently displayed, so an active filter or a
status view other than "All" can hide an existing member.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

classes.name: MemberTableComp
classes.description:
Represents the members table component on the Members page.
Contains rows of members with their name, email, roles, groups, status, etc.
The table columns are: Name, Email, Roles, Groups, Shared, Status, Current Rate.

methods.name: getNumberOfRows
methods.description:
Returns the number of member rows in the table, or 0 when the table is
absent entirely.

Unlike the boards table, this does not special-case an empty-state
placeholder row, so verify the members table's empty rendering before
relying on a result of 1.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: getRowByIndex
methods.description: Gets a member row by its zero-based index.
methods.prerequisites: The Members page is open and the table has at least `index + 1` rows
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: getRowByMemberName
methods.description:
Gets a member row by the member's name, returning the first match.
Throws if no row matches.
methods.prerequisites: The Members page is open and a member with this name is displayed
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: hasMemberWithName
methods.description:
Checks whether a member with the given name is present in the table.
Matches against the whole row's text, so a name appearing in another
column (an email, for example) also counts as a match.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: getAllMemberNames
methods.description:
Returns the names of all members currently displayed in the table.
Reflects the active filter and status view, not the full project roster.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

classes.name: MemberTableRowComp
classes.description:
Represents a single row in the members table.
Each row shows a member's name, email, roles, groups, shared status, status, and current rate.
The row has a "..." context menu with "Manage roles" and "Remove member" options.
"Manage roles" expands inline with role checkboxes and Change/Cancel buttons.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the member's display name from the Name column.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the member's email address from the Email column.
methods.prerequisites: This member row is displayed and the Email column is populated
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: getRolesText
methods.description:
Returns the raw text of the Roles cell. A member with several roles
yields them as a single string, so assert with `toContain` rather than
exact equality.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description:
Returns the text of the row's Status cell — "active" for a member whose
account is usable, "invited" while a sent invitation is still pending
registration/activation, "locked" for a blocked account.

The rendered casing is not guaranteed, so compare case-insensitively.
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: clickManageRoles
methods.description:
Opens the row's "..." context menu and clicks "Manage roles", then waits
for the inline role editor to appear. This is the gateway to
{@link toggleRole}, {@link isRoleChecked}, {@link clickChangeButton}, and
{@link clickCancelButton} — none of them work until it has been called.
methods.observableState: The row expands inline showing a role checkbox per project role, plus Change and Cancel buttons

methods.name: toggleRole
methods.description:
Toggles a role checkbox in the inline manage roles editor. This flips the
current state rather than setting it, and the change is not saved until
{@link clickChangeButton} is called.
methods.prerequisites: The inline role editor is open — call {@link clickManageRoles} first
methods.observableState: The role checkbox flips state; nothing is persisted until Change is clicked

methods.name: isRoleChecked
methods.description:
Returns whether a role checkbox is currently checked. Reflects unsaved
editor state, not necessarily what is persisted on the server.
methods.prerequisites: The inline role editor is open — call {@link clickManageRoles} first
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: clickChangeButton
methods.description: Clicks "Change" to save pending role edits, then waits for the page load.
methods.prerequisites: The inline role editor is open — call {@link clickManageRoles} first
methods.observableState: The role changes are persisted, the inline editor closes, and the row's Roles cell shows the new roles

methods.name: clickCancelButton
methods.description: Clicks "Cancel" to discard pending role edits.
methods.prerequisites: The inline role editor is open — call {@link clickManageRoles} first
methods.observableState: The inline editor closes and the member's roles are unchanged

methods.name: removeMember
methods.description:
Removes this member from the project end to end: opens the row context
menu, clicks "Remove member", and confirms in the Primer dialog.

The confirmation is a `data-turbo-method="delete"` link, clicked via
`dispatchEvent` because Primer dialogs otherwise detach the element
mid-click. Afterwards the browser navigates back to the members page URL
captured before the removal.
methods.prerequisites: This member row is displayed and the current user may remove members
methods.observableState: The member is removed from the project, their row disappears, and the browser returns to the members list
